title: MME vol: Empowering Multimodal Large Language Models with Evol-Instruct

layout.note: Four stacked levels along a vertical arrow at the left: the Seed level at the bottom with the photo and one card, then Round-1 with three cards, Round-2 with three cards and Round-3 with two large cards; coloured arrows climb from level to level and a three-item arrow legend sits at the bottom right.

lesson: Draw iterative data evolution as a vertical round axis with real example cards per round, arrow colours keyed to the type of transformation, and kept versus eliminated cards told apart by border style, tint and a True or False header; growing tree icons turn the iteration into a metaphor.
